test_title: PYST 45: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 31 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in the brackets to fill in the blank and complete the sentence.**

I don't want to offend him, so I'm hesitant to say or do anything ______ (polite).
solution: The correct answer is **"rude."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Polite"** means having or showing good manners or respect for others. (सुशील और दूसरों का सम्‍मान करने वाला; नम्र, शिष्‍ट) • **Example**: *The assistants in that shop are always very helpful and **polite**__.* • The antonym of **"polite"** is** "rude."** • **"Rude" **means showing a lack of respect or consideration for others. (अशिष्‍ट (किसी के प्रति) (किसी बात पर)) __ • **Example**:* It’s **rude**__ to interrupt when people are speaking.* • The correct answer is Option 3. **Correct sentence**: *I don't want to offend him, so I'm hesitant to say or do anything __**rude**__.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Bluff"**, means to deceive or mislead someone. (झूठा विश्‍वास दिलाना, झांसा देना) • **"Kind"**, means having or showing a friendly, generous, or considerate nature. (समान गुणों वाले व्यक्तियों का समूह; वर्ग) • **"Abrupt"**, means sudden and unexpected, often in a way that is rude or unfriendly. (आकस्मिक और अप्रत्‍याशित) 36:T6c0, The correct answer is **"Not feeling comfortable in a new environment."**
